Synthetic tactic presets for the 2.20 tactics tests (tests/native/test_tactics_page.h). Not anyone's real preset: the values are a
fixed pattern (17*i + 31*n mod 101). They copy only the SHAPE of the five 10-16 community slider presets in Cassio's store (schema 1,
build 6AC07E31-2145C000, layout fbchunks-454-bc650, the top-level include_unverified true, note lengths 1038/1208/988/1082/833 bytes,
88/84/72/104/71 slider ids of the game's own slider map) - the shape that made 2.12..2.19 refuse every file (note limit 300).
